en:
Me, second?
Now that I've actually been picked, I'm getting nervous.
Umm, let's see...
Okay, I'll start by introducing myself.
I'm... Reiko Fukuzawa.
I'm in Class 1-G.
Nice to meet you all!
Um, it's {a}... right?
You're a first-year too, aren't you?
Have you gotten used to your class yet?
I mean, the first term of first year is tough, with everything being new.{p}

High school isn't compulsory, you know, so the classes and everything are totally different from before...
And there's tons of stuff to decide, like committees and clubs...
It takes everyone a while to settle in.
Huh, me...?{p}

Ahahaha...
I've gotten totally used to it already.
I'm not really the shy type, so I make friends fast.
Maybe I've got a talent for it...?
...Not that that matters at all.
Hey, hey, {a}, has anything weird been happening in your class?
Until a little while ago, things were really rough in my class.
There was this little incident...
And that incident was......{p}Well?
Try and guess, {a}.
A transfer student showed up.
There was a test.
Things kept going missing.
I have no idea.

A string of thefts, basically.
When did it start, I wonder...{p}

I think the first one to notice was Yashiro, from the cleanliness committee.
During end-of-day homeroom, she suddenly said this:
"Um...
The dustpan's missing. Does anyone know where it is?"{p}

...That's right!
The first thing to vanish was the dustpan.

At our school, everybody cleans at the same time, right?
And afterward, the cleanliness committee always goes around checking the cleaning supplies.
Because, you know...
They have to swap out worn-out brooms and buckets with holes in them for new ones.
Especially in my class: the boys are so rough with everything, it all gets wrecked in no time.{p}You've done stuff like that too, haven't you, {a}? Snapped a broom, or mangled the end of a mop...?
I have.
I haven't.

Ahaha... I knew it.
I figured you had.
Poor cleanliness committee kids...
Don't make so much trouble for them, okay?{p}

That day...
After cleaning, Yashiro was checking the supplies like always, and apparently one of the dustpans was missing.
...The boys broke another one.
That's what most of the class thought.{p}

"This is your doing, isn't it!
How many do you have to break before you're satisfied?★
If you break any more, you're paying for them!"
With that, Yashiro glared around at the boys who were always making a racket.{p}

"We don't know anything about that!
Quit blaming everything on us!"
The first to speak up was Shimada.
He's a member of the cheer squad.
Hot-blooded, I guess you'd say: the type who can't sit still when there's a commotion.
"I don't know anything about some dustpan!"
He denied it, red in the face, but nobody believed him.
I mean...
Shimada had just snapped a broom not long before.{p}

Goes to show how you act every day really matters, huh?
You'd better watch yourself too, {a}.
...Anyway.
That time, it got chalked up to Shimada and his crowd of boys.
But the real problem came after that.
From that day on, things started going missing all over the class.
I heard all sorts of stories.
...Um, hold on a sec.
Let me remember...
There was Endo's pencil case.
Imai's key chain, and Matsumoto's commuter pass case.
Morioka was shrieking that her watch was gone, and Takigawa was upset because a book she'd borrowed from the library had vanished.
The girls in the class were in an uproar, saying there was a thief.
Oh yeah, I was a victim too, you know.
Somebody stole my precious wallet!
Classes were over for the day, and I opened my bag to get ready to go home, right?
And then...
There was money spilled all over the inside of my bag, jingling around.
I didn't want it scattering everywhere, so I hurried to gather it up.
I figured my wallet must have a hole in it, so I looked for it... but it wasn't there.
No matter where I searched in my bag, I couldn't find the wallet.
The charm and the hair salon card I'd kept inside it were still there, but the wallet itself was gone.{p}Isn't that awful?
That's really awful!
If the stuff inside was safe, isn't that fine?

You sure don't mind saying cold things, do you, {a}?
...Sure, I'm glad what was inside was safe too.
But that wallet was precious to me. My big sister gave it to me as a present for getting into high school.
I loved it so much...
You don't even know that, and you go, 'If the stuff inside was safe...'? That's kind of insensitive.
Ugh, this is why I can't stand boys.
You're just like the boys in my class.
Even when the girls are in trouble, they act like it's none of their business.
Seriously, they're totally useless...{p}

At first, we were careful on our own, you know, like not bringing valuables or never taking them off.
But...
Sadly, it didn't do any good at all.
Even things locked away in lockers would disappear before anyone noticed.
With the thefts still going on, everyone started getting on edge...
It felt like you couldn't trust anyone anymore.{p}

"Back when the dustpan thing happened...
Shimada got awfully worked up, didn't he?"
"Maybe he snapped after getting blamed for breaking the dustpan..."
"Who knows, maybe he didn't break the dustpan either. Maybe he stole it."
That's the kind of thing the girls were whispering to each other.
I bet the rumors started with Yashiro.{p}
And in response...{p}

"If you're gonna accuse people, show us some proof first!"
...That's what the boys said. They all took Shimada's side.
The class split right down the middle.
Boys on one side, girls on the other, going head to head.{p}

Hasn't anything like this happened in 1-E?
If it were you, {a}, whose side would you take?
The boys' side
The girls' side
Neither side

Figures you'd answer that way.
Is that the whole guy-friendship thing?
Huh, me...?
I wasn't on either side.{p}

That friend... her name's Sanae Motoki, and she's a really unusual girl.
Sometimes she says things that make no sense, but later it turns out they were important prophecies, which is scary.
But she's not a bad person at all.
There's just something about her you can't dislike...
...Oops, Sanae's got nothing to do with this right now.
Maybe I'll tell you about her some other time.
Only...
Sanae went,
"Ew. That one isn't keeping to their territory."
She muttered it under her breath.
Right in the classroom, while everyone was making a fuss about the stolen watch.
She clammed up after that, but it makes you wonder, right?{p}

Anyway...
Because of all this, our class became the one where the boys and girls got along worst in the whole school.
Everyone was giving dirty looks, every conversation was tense, and the whole class felt prickly.
And I'd been so excited about the new school year...
School life felt kind of... puce.{p}Hey, {a}...
Do you know what color puce is?
I know.
I don't know.

Oh, really...
You don't know.
Hmm...
Actually, I don't know either.{p}

Ahahaha...
...But you can sort of picture it, right?{p}

Back then, my mood was totally puce.
So I decided I was going to find the thief and catch them, no matter what.
With all this fuss, not one person had seen anybody suspicious...
Which means the thief was showing up whenever the classroom was empty, right?
Just what was going on in that empty classroom...
I was going to see it with my own eyes.

My chance came soon enough.
That day...
We had P.E., and I happened to have a bit of a cold.
I used that to skip P.E. and sneak off to hide in the classroom.
After watching everyone leave, I hid inside the cleaning closet.{p}

All... by myself, you know.
Pretty brave of me, huh?
Huh...?
You're saying I'm just reckless?
You're so mean, {a}!
And here I am, going out of my way to help with your interview...
Maybe I'll just stop talking...
......Oh, look, you're flustered.{p}

Ahaha, you don't know what to do, do you, {a}?
So cuuute!
Looks like you're sorry for saying something mean.
Okay.
I forgive you.
...See, I'm just that nice.
All right, I'll go on with the story.{p}

So I was holding my breath inside the cleaning closet...
Cleaning closets really stink inside, you know.
Musty, I guess you'd say...
Why did I ever think of hiding in a place like that?
But I was pretty desperate at the time.
I didn't really mind the smell.
Besides...

...Clack.
Before even a few minutes had passed, I sensed the door opening with a faint sound.
My heart pounding, I focused on where the sound had come from.

The thief...?
...It had to be.
I couldn't hear any footsteps, but I could sense someone walking around the classroom.
Did they think nobody was there...?
How shocked would they be if I jumped out right now?
That's what I was thinking.{p}Well?
If it were you, {a}, would you go out?
Or would you wait and see a little longer?
Go out
Wait and see

...I see.
Same as me.
I mean, you don't know what kind of person the thief is.
If they had a knife or something, you'd be the one in danger.
And unless you catch them red-handed, you're stuck if they play dumb.
I fought down the urge to burst out and stayed still in that cramped cleaning closet.
And then...
Right about when I figured the one I took for the thief had reached the middle of the classroom, their presence suddenly just vanished.{p}

...Why?
How could their presence just vanish?★
I kind of panicked.
Maybe what I'd sensed before was just my imagination...
I even started to feel that way.{p}

But I wasn't going to figure it out by just thinking about it forever.
So I worked up my nerve and decided to come out of the cleaning closet.{p}You'd do the same, right, {a}?
Yes
No
I nervously opened the door and stepped out of the cleaning closet, looking all around.{p}

There was no one to be seen in the classroom.
I started to think it really had just been my imagination.
But then...
When I looked closer, something black was rustling around under one of the desks.{p}

That really made my heart jump...
It looked just like some monster out of a sci-fi movie!
But I only thought that for the first few seconds...
The longer I stared at it, the more I got the feeling I'd seen that black thing somewhere before.

"Shimada...?"
That's what I said.
And then the black thing gave a startled jerk, and when it did, it bonked its head on the desk.{p}
Ahaha...

Sure enough, the black thing was Shimada.
The black thing I'd seen was his hair.
Shimada wanted to clear himself of the theft accusations, so he'd been trying to catch the thief himself.
So, just like me, he'd skipped P.E. and hidden in the classroom.
Ahaha...
If we'd known from the start, we could've worked together, right?{p}

...In the end, nothing got stolen that time.
No, actually...
After that, there were never any more thefts in our class at all.
I don't know if it's connected or not, but...
After that, a little incident happened.
You know, there was that teacher, Onoda.
Not that I knew Onoda personally or anything...
Just a few weeks ago, Onoda committed suicide and left a mysterious note, remember?
You don't know?
I'm pretty sure the newspaper club covered it too...{p}

Oh, there's the paper with that article right here!
You should've said so sooner...
Look, read this part carefully.

'I knew it was wrong, but once I had acquired a taste for stealing, I could never rid myself of it.
It was not that I wanted things or money; my body would move on its own, craving that indescribable thrill.
But at last, a student has seen me in the act.
I am unfit to be a teacher.'{p}

...See, it's right there, isn't it?
If Onoda, who wrote this note, was the thief behind the thefts in our class...
then it means Onoda thought they'd been seen by Shimada or me, and committed suicide over it.
Even though we never saw anyone else at all...{p}

Did you know?
They say people with a guilty conscience fear other people more than they need to.
I bet Onoda saw us there that time and figured we'd spotted them too.
And then, looking back on what they'd been doing all along, Onoda suddenly got terrified.
...That's only my guess, though.{p}

My class...
These days it's turned into a really close, friendly class.
And it looks like the suspicion on Shimada's been totally cleared up too...
I guess it's a case of 'after the rain, the ground grows firm'?
Nothing big has happened since, either.
Well, I do run into weird incidents now and then.{p}

Ahaha...
I mean, like I told you before, Sanae's in my class.
...Her story's for another time.
Today I want to hear the others' stories, so not now.{p}Okay then, shall we move on to the next story?
...{a}, whose turn is it next?{p}

That's right.
Good guess.
...Is that what you think I'd say?
It's pretty rare for a transfer student to show up less than a month after the entrance ceremony.
Well, I can't say it would never happen.
...But sorry, that answer's wrong.
The incident in my class wasn't anything like that.
I don't know why, but things kept going missing in our class all the time.{p}

Oh yeah, we had the school-wide exams, right?
We're getting our papers back right about now.
My heart's pounding every single day.
...But sorry, that answer's wrong.
The incident in my class wasn't anything like that.
I don't know why, but things kept going missing in our class all the time.{p}

The incident was that a transfer student came to our class.
...Just kidding, that's a lie.{p}

Ahaha, don't get mad.
It was just a little joke.
The truth is... things kept going missing in our class all the time.
That part's true.{p}

Really? I wonder...
The other day I heard a window got broken in a first-year classroom during cleaning time...
Wasn't that Class E?
...Oh well, never mind.
Don't be too rough with the school's equipment, okay?{p}

Ahaha...
It's not like I suspect you or anything, {a}.{p}

...Right?
That wallet was a really special present my big sister gave me to celebrate getting into high school...
I absolutely loved it.
And yet...
The boys in my class said, if the stuff inside was safe, what's the big deal?
Honestly, how insensitive can you get?
Ugh, this is why I can't stand boys.{p}

The boys in my class are totally hopeless.
They're not dependable at all...{p}

Whoa.
So that's the kind of guy you are, {a}.
Being on the girls' side sounds nice and all.
But maybe you don't have many guy friends?{p}
Ahaha, you kind of give off that vibe.{p}

Huh, me...?
I wasn't on either side.{p}

Whoa, you know it?
You really know a lot, {a}.
The thing is...
I don't actually know what color it is.
Ahaha...
But, I mean, just from hearing the name, you can kind of picture it, right?{p}

I see...
So you'd step out at this point, {a}.
Maybe I should've done that too...
I didn't, though.
I mean, I had no idea what kind of person the thief was.
If they had a knife or something, I'd be the one in danger.
And if I didn't catch them red-handed, I'd be stuck if they just played dumb.
So I fought back the itch to jump out and stayed perfectly still inside that cramped cleaning closet.

And then...
The person who seemed to be the thief moved to about the middle of the classroom, then slowly started going through the desks around there.{p}

Yeah, I saw everything.
The cleaning closet in our class is all beat up, so you can peek out through the gap along the edge of the door.

But, you see...
That means I got a good look at the one behind the thefts.
If the thief found out about that, I think I'd be in big trouble.
I might even get killed.
That's why I've kept quiet until now, but...
I'll tell you, right here, right now.
The thief I saw is a student at this school.

That's......
......On second thought, it's a secret.

Ahahaha...
See, suspecting your own classmates doesn't feel good, right?
And the thefts have stopped now, too...
If whoever did it has learned their lesson, I think that's good enough.{p}

...Sorry, {a}.
That wasn't much of a scary story, was it?
I'll tell you a scary one next time.
Don't worry.
If there's one thing I know tons of, it's scary stories.
I mean, like I said earlier, Sanae's in my class.
Stick around her and you'll have a scary experience or two in no time.{p}Okay then, {a}.
You have to pick the next person.
...Who's next?{p}
I tried to open the door and step out.
Just then...

"Waaaaaaah☆"
I heard a boy scream.
Inside the classroom...
Not far from the cleaning closet I was in.
On reflex, I reached out to push the door open.
But whether it was rusted or just badly fitted, the door wouldn't budge.
I tried to put more strength into my hands, but I'd been sitting still in that cramped space so long that my arms and legs had gone weirdly numb, and they wouldn't do what I wanted.
Honestly, I really panicked then.
Rattling the whole closet, I shoved at the door with everything I had.

Then I threw my whole body against it like I was ramming it, and I finally managed to get out.
The moment I got out, a blinding light came pouring in.{p}

I'd been in the dark until then, so in an instant I couldn't see a thing.
...Oh right, it was still before noon.
I think that's what went through my head.
Ahaha, even though that was no time for it.
The blinding light wasn't coming in from the windows.{p}

Floating almost dead center in the classroom was a pure-white glowing object, and the light was pouring out of it.
...Hmm, that's not quite right, actually.
To put it precisely...
There was no such thing as a glowing object; it was a rift in space that had split wide open in the classroom.
What had blinded me was light from another space, leaking out of that rift.
It was a strange light.
You know how when the sun's too bright, you can't keep your eyes open?
But that light never hurt at all, no matter how long I looked at it.
Then, maybe because my eyes adjusted, I could even make out something like a black shadow inside the light.
It didn't take me long to work out exactly what it was.
...Because I'd seen it before.{p}

That shadow-like thing was Shimada.
Shimada had been hiding in the classroom too, just like me.
...I bet he wanted to prove he wasn't the thief.
"S-somebody help meee!"
Shimada was screaming desperately, his face twisted in agony.{p}
But his screams were no use; he got sucked deep into the rift in space.{p}

Once he was out of sight, the rift started closing fast...
And in no time at all, it was sealed shut.

I told everyone about it, but nobody believed me...
The only one who understood was Sanae.
"To sever the path, one human soul is needed..."
That's what Sanae said, crying.
I didn't really understand exactly what she meant, but I did get that Shimada had been sacrificed so the rift could close.{p}

And so, here's what I think...
Maybe that rift was behind the string of thefts in our classroom.
Ever since Shimada got sucked in, the thefts stopped dead, after all.
Even now that he's missing, Shimada's still being blamed for the thefts.
Poor guy, right?
If that rift in space showed up again, people would see I wasn't lying, but then somebody else would have to be sacrificed, wouldn't they?
But that's way too scary, so I'd rather it never showed up.
Besides, I know how to close the rift, but I don't know what makes it open.
Sanae doesn't seem to know either...
When will that rift appear again...?
When I think about that, I just can't relax.
There's no saying it'll only show up in our classroom.
It could even appear right here, right now.{p}

Well, if that happens, you'll lay down your life for us, right, {a}?
Ahaha...{p}

Relax.
Nothing's happened so far, after all.
Well, I do run into weird incidents now and then.
I mean, Sanae's in my class.
{a}...
If you want to graduate in one piece, maybe you should try asking her for help.
But her story's for another time.
Today I want to hear the others' stories, so not now.{p}Okay then, shall we move on to the next story?
...{a}, whose turn is it next?{p}
